summary: Tested Consulting Meetings page with SSOT architecture improvements. All new features working correctly: Project filter with auto-date range fill, Company column (renamed from Client), Date with day names, Meeting Detail dialog with Print button and Project Meeting Progress section.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 404 - Not Found (pre-existing issue from iteration 184)

issues: HTML warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> - This is a React DevTools warning, not visible to users but may cause hydration issues

page_load.details: Page loads with 23 meetings as expected

project_filter_dropdown.details: Shows projects with company names (e.g., 'Digital Transformation Initiative' with 'Acme Manufacturing Ltd')

project_filter_auto_date_range.details: Selecting 'Digital Transformation Initiative' auto-fills Duration: 01/28/2026 to 06/17/2026 (project start/end dates)

filter_by_project.details: Filter correctly shows 2 meetings for Digital Transformation Initiative project

clear_button.details: Clear button resets all filters including project and dates, shows all 23 meetings

company_column.details: Column header renamed from 'Client' to 'Company', shows company names correctly

date_with_day_name.details: Date column shows day names (e.g., 'Mon, Apr 13, 2026', 'Fri, Apr 10, 2026')

meeting_detail_dialog.details: Clicking meeting row opens Meeting Details dialog

meeting_detail_print_button.details: Print button visible in dialog header

project_meeting_progress.details: Shows Committed/Completed/Pending stats (e.g., 22 Committed, 1 Completed, 21 Pending)

filter_summary_project_badge.details: Blue badge shows 'Project: Digital Transformation Initiative' (bg-blue-50 text-blue-700)

filter_summary_duration_badge.details: Amber badge shows 'Duration: Jan 28 - Jun 17, 2026' (bg-amber-50 text-amber-700)

critical_code_review_comments: HTML warning about <tr> cannot be child of <span> appears in console - may be related to dynamic rendering but not affecting functionality
